text:
Olivia Zhang: Quick sync 305 5 - partner wants us to publish the marketplace listing + co-announcement next Wed. Need clarity on which security/compliance artifacts we can link publicly (SOC excerpt, pen-test blurb, integration checklist). Can legal + sec ok this by EOD Tue?

Diego Fernandez: Dropping the draft PR copy here in thread. Long story short: we should avoid asserting control scopes. Proposed artifacts: soc_cover_redacted.pdf, pentest_summary_redacted.pdf, integration_matrix_public.pdf, signed_msa_stub.pdf (redacted).

Hannah Yoon: Security: we can publish the cover page of the SOC report if partner agrees and we redact the firm name if requested. Pentest: publish only a 3-line executive summary + CVSS counts. No exploit PoCs, no logs, no IPs.

Priya Nair: Confirmed. Also require partner sign-off for any artifact with their branding. Suggest phrasing: "Partner maintains SOC2 Type II attestation; detailed reports are available to partners under NDA."

Olivia Zhang: Partner legal requested a 72-hr review window once we share the public bundle. That pushes timeline if we want to ship Wed. They also want an embargo until the joint PR goes live.

Diego Fernandez: Can we offer presigned artifacts with 5-day expiry? Partner prefers 7-day. Who will generate presigns?

artifact-uploader: Uploaded: integration_matrix_public_v3.pdf (owner: Diego Fernandez)

Priya Nair: We'll do security redaction pass Wed AM. Owner assignments: SOC cover - Olivia; Pentest summary - Priya; Integration matrix - Diego; MSA stub - Hannah. Please confirm.

LegalBot: Legal checklist (auto): 1) Attestation wording verified; 2) No control IDs published; 3) Embargo clause included; 4) NDA confirmed; 5) Press liability language present.

Hannah Yoon: I'll create the redacted pentest summary: 1-paragraph findings, CVSS tally, remediation status. Draft will be posted here for quick review.

Diego Fernandez: Presign plan: we'll do aws presign with 604800 expiry unless partner pushes back. Command we use: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-internal/marketplace/partnerZ/soc_cover_redacted.pdf --expires-in 604800`

Olivia Zhang: Ok final timeline: Tue EOD legal + sec sign-off -> send bundle to partner Wed AM -> partner review window (72h) -> target announce next Mon. If partner wants longer, we delay. Tagging @Priya for security review urgency.

Priya Nair: Got it. I'll prioritize the pentest redaction and flag any issues by Tue noon.

Diego Fernandez: Will prepare manifest.csv with filename, owner, presign_url (placeholder), expiry, redaction_notes and post it Tue noon.

Olivia Zhang: Thanks team. If anything blocks the presign or we need to reassign owners, call it out now so we can avoid last-minute delays. :spiral_calendar:
